memo.headline: AI Inference shows standalone demand but weak standalone revenue, so diagnose the losses before committing to it as its own category.
memo.evidence: Behavior is weak: standalone usage share is 12.0% against a 25.0% effective threshold, though 52 standalone accounts retain at 80.0% over the 12-month window (n=30), close to attached at 82.6% (n=23). Pipeline is stronger: standalone demand share is 30.0%, 73.3% of it buyer-initiated, and win rate is 53.8% on 13 closed deals versus 85.7% bundled. Self-serve paid conversion within the 90-day window is 12.2% without voice and 23.8% with voice. Samples are small and the data is synthetic. Stronger usage share or a higher win rate would change the call.
